authoringStatement.statement: This ledger separates checked-in contracts, inherited validated facts, algorithmic laws, project policy, resource policy, and independent test-oracle policy. It does not claim external domain-expert review.

claims.text: Matched, entering, and leaving arcs have exact correlated endpoint, motion, identity, and gap shapes.
V1 is a pure synchronous theory operation over exact V0 automatic-candidate frames.
Schema, policy, frame, role, identity, lock, no-assignment, and work-limit failures are typed and all-or-nothing.
Voice identities are request-local, canonical, inherited on match, retired on leave, and allocated after path selection on enter.

authorities.title: Independent fixture and brute-force proof policy

claims.text: Replay, immutable outputs, and input nonmutation are independently proven without clocks or ambient state.
Reviewed small cases are exhaustively enumerated by a test-only oracle that shares no selection code with production.
Positive, near-miss, transposition, and mutation witnesses are linked reciprocally by stable IDs.

authorities.title: Deterministic V1 work, memory, numeric, role, and payload limits

claims.text: Production visits a bounded dynamic-programming matrix and never enumerates permutations or every Delannoy path.
A breached test-seam counter returns limit.voice_assignment_work_exceeded with no partial result.
Every work and tracked-record population has an explicit exact maximum and reviewed exact-plus-one seam witness.
Every match advances both low-to-high prefixes, so crossing is structurally impossible.
Only correlated match, leave, and enter predecessor records form a complete path.
Path comparison uses the complete bounded record sequence with declared operation and ordinal order.

authorities.title: Versioned V1 cost, role-reporting, motion, and deterministic path policy

claims.text: Enter and leave each cost exactly 12 in policy version 1.
Motion, common-tone, spacing, guide-doubling, omitted-color, and span facts remain inspectable instead of becoming one taste score.
Stationary-pair, oblique, contrary, parallel, and similar are distinct mechanical motion relations.

authorities.title: Inherited domain and V0 spelling, provenance, role-source, and spacing laws

claims.text: Degree identity includes number and alteration; null slash-bass provenance is never fabricated into a degree role.
MIDI, pitch class, spelled pitch class, spelled pitch, and octave remain separate exact questions.
crowdedLowIntervals uses the exact versioned V0 low-register spacing bands.
Guide and color roles come from exact selected-realization degree lists and correlated per-voice provenance.
